summary:
Complete audit and status calculation engine implementation for cscdost.com.
- Authoritative Asia/Kolkata date and closing time calculation engine in `/src/utils/sarkariStatus.ts`.
- Complete audit of recruitment and admission records in `/src/data/sarkariData.ts`, including SSC CGL 2024 correction (17,727 vacancies, application window 24/06/2024 to 27/07/2024 at 23:00 IST), SSC JE Paper-I Admit Card, RRB calendar, and CGL city slips.
- Ingestion of newly verified circulars across the target websites (JKSSB answer keys, Kashmir University B.Ed examination center notice, Cluster University FYUGP migration, Indian Army TGC-145).
- Enforcement across the Homepage, Post details, and Apply flows disallowing assisted form filling for concluded/inactive recruitment cycles.
